lines: Shit... what are these guys...? They're not... human... uaaarrghhh!!!
The leader of the Rakshasa Orcs fell to the scorching ground, torn to pieces by Rinko-senpai and Sakura-sensei.
You underestimate your enemies and still call yourselves a warrior clan?
The giant Rakshasa Orcs were falling one after another and the place became a true hellscape.
I'm starting to get dizzy! What's gonna come this time!?
As Fu-, er... as my little brother said earlier, if these are not illusions...
Then did this intruder or whoever send us here on purpose to get us to fight with Rakshasa Orcs...?
So next up something even more dangerous is on the way?
Whoa!? ...Huh? This is just... Gosha Academy.
We're back... Most likely the intruder is here.
There was an extremely strange-looking creature in the direction Rinko was looking.
I see, it really is an octopus.
≪I already told you not to confuse me for an o-, octopus, didn't I!?≫
≪We are Brain Flayers. A highly intelligent species!!!≫
What kind of intelligent species would have those weird Orcs attack us!?
≪That was just because you all tried to kill me without any discussion!!≫
We already decided to eliminate you, so give up!
≪You decide matters of life and death too casually! I told you to hear me out!!≫
(This back and forth feels like something I experienced earlier...)
Wait, Sakura, why don't we at least listen to what he has to say? You chased after him without properly discussing it, didn't you?
I'm telling you, that thing is absolutely a bad guy!
Well, let's just listen. For now anyway.
≪Ohh!? Looks like not all lower lifeforms are completely useless!!≫
Hey... are you trying to pick a fight?
≪Oh, excuse me. I am an honest individual who cannot lie. I did not mean any harm by it.≫
...Whatever. Anyways, let's hear what you have to say. All of it.
(Maybe this thing holds the key to how nee-chan... I mean, how Rinko-senpai and I can go back to our world.)
